resolution.note: krn pr ship --worktree ships from the root; skills use it

title: Ship from the repository root so cleanup never deletes the shell's directory
body:
Outcome: `krn pr ship --worktree <path>` ships a branch worktree from the repository root; the lead and lane briefs use it, so a merged ship no longer ends the Bash call with exit 1.
Why: on 2026-11-09 both ships in session 3e700b2a printed `verdict: merged` and then `pwd: error retrieving current directory`, exit 1, because ship removed the worktree the shell stood in; every ship reads as a failure.
Proof: test/ci/ship.test.ts ships with runtime cwd at the root and --worktree, and every git call runs in the worktree.
Scope: src/ci/ship.ts, test/ci/ship.test.ts, .agents/skills/krn-lead/SKILL.md, .agents/skills/krn-lead/lanes.md.
